If native==AMD size, OememDxe skips APCB regardless of stale APCB size. If native!=AMD and writeback fails after SetVariable, the next callback sees equal sizes and may skip repair. 225 conditional combinations passed.
Остаточный риск / блокер: Native browser route, value representation, notification order, alternate CBS RouteConfig and actual memory selection not proven; do not inject failures or write variables. 128 MiB candidate, not guarantee. B04 stays partial.

Доказательство: tools/uma_audit.py SHA256 aaba0d5ce548b99d3bf335c85721843bcc9e41cf05888db0ccbeb7465a0a58fc, Git blob 1ed289ae7cf721bebc5503ee4a08c11927730665. Nine capture/compare assertions plus model tests, py_compile and container read-only capture passed. Kernel docs https://docs.kernel.org/gpu/amdgpu/driver-misc.html and module parameters https://docs.kernel.org/gpu/amdgpu/module-parameters.html ; source amdgpu_vram_mgr.c at https://kernel.googlesource.com/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/next/linux-next/%2B/3271faf42d135bcf569c3ff6af55c21858eec212/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/amdgpu/amdgpu_vram_mgr.c reports real_vram_size. Picasso GTT display support discussed at https://lists.openwall.net/linux-kernel/2025/07/22/932 .
Остаточный риск / блокер: No new M75n capture. Check same kernel, driver parameters and hardware, local display, repeated boot and actual workload; GTT is not permanently reserved VRAM. Default 64 MiB comparison tolerance heuristic, no automatic hardware stability verdict; missing firmware map is explicitly null, compare is based on MemTotal/VRAM. Exact 1002:15d8 matching required.

Вывод: Independent Picasso report suggests a low-cost additional before/after test, not a Lenovo regression finding.
Доказательство: Indexed Dell community report 2026-11-25 on Ryzen 7 3700U (Picasso, microcode 0810810E) alleges RDRAND/RDSEED failure after 1.38/1.39, attributes it to PSP; direct page fetch failed: https://www.dell.com/community/en/conversations/vostro/vostro-3515-ryzen-7-3700u-bios-138139-break-rdrandrdseed-131-and-1361-work-regression-traced-to-amd-psp-firmware/6b072832d46bb6e1a8cb867d . Existing M75n platform reconstruction found equal mapped PSP payload hashes. tools/rng_smoke.c SHA256 90ffeebcaa76ef4c357b48893b44bfa489d77af6460044113189a90318daf01c; compiled cc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror and ran all six widths/instructions, 4096 successful calls each on container CPU, no repeated/zero/all-ones samples. Linux documents BIOS-related RDRAND workarounds.
Остаточный риск / блокер: Report is not independent proof of its causal diagnosis; different platform. No evidence of M75n RNG regression, no guarantee from matching PSP hashes. CPUID and bounded smoke test only; normal RDSEED carry-clear and occasional 16-bit zero/ones/repeats are possible. Not statistical entropy or cryptographic validation. Hardware pending.

Вывод: Picasso supports PMCx02B (LsSmiRx); direct per-CPU SMI counts can complement hardware latency sampling.
Доказательство: AMD OSRR 56255 rev3.03 July 2018 p153, family17h models00h–2Fh: PMCx02B counts received SMIs, unit mask reserved. https://www.amd.com/content/dam/amd/en/documents/processor-tech-docs/programmer-references/56255_OSRR.pdf ; kernel hwlat documentation https://docs.kernel.org/trace/hwlat_detector.html . Use perf stat -a -A -I 1000 -e cpu/event=0x2b,umask=0/ -- sleep 60, repeat before/after; compare same per-CPU scope, inspect counter running time; optional maintenance-window hwlat. Linux efivarfs is EFI runtime service interface, not proof of specific SmiVariable handler.
Остаточный риск / блокер: No actual M75n measurement; container AMD family25/model17, perf absent. A received SMI is not a unique platform interrupt; do not add per-thread counters as unique events. Count gives neither duration nor handler attribution. hwlat gaps can have other causes, sampling is intrusive. B03 remains partial.

Вывод: Type-level identity independently corroborated: nonvolatile APOB copy, not an executable PSP firmware entry.
Доказательство: coreboot PSP Integration Guide, BIOS Directory Table Entry Types 0x61 APOB target, 0x62 BIOS reset image, 0x63 APOB data NV; https://doc.coreboot.org/soc/amd/psp_integration.html . AMD-authored EDK2 Vangogh reference enum APOB_NV_COPY=0x63 also describes S3 use: https://patchew.org/EDK2/20240126060050.1725-1-duke.zhai%40amd.com/20240126060050.1725-5-duke.zhai%40amd.com/ (indexed excerpt only). Prior raw accounting 1.24→1.33: 41436 changed bytes categorized type63, 5590595 total; directory metadata equal. Distinguish live-vendor data from code, not an assertion of payload contents.
Остаточный риск / блокер: Type mapping confirmed from external documentation; no new ROM bytes, actual APOB header, valid record, erased state, selection and 0x20043/44 not checked. 41436 bytes not automatically dismissed as harmless; B09 remains partial.

Вывод: Read-only inventory distinguishes missing references, unlisted entries, payload rewrites and unreadable variables.
Доказательство: UEFI 2.10 Boot Manager https://uefi.org/specs/UEFI/2.10/03_Boot_Manager.html and Device Path https://uefi.org/specs/UEFI/2.10/10_Protocols_Device_Path_Protocol.html (BBS node type5/subtype1 identifies legacy format, not label). P2-31 max-ID+1 and three appended IDs, candidate collision if unlisted IDs or 16-bit wrap, actual collision handling/trigger unresolved. tools/boot_inventory.py SHA256 3edc0d3ccb334068cbc137ba79651f1699b49da0a3486204a12ea1d627962f91, Git blob 6a64763c5893691a2e040e212df272b10f1125c8; 9 synthetic checks and py_compile passed. Reads only global BootOrder/BootNext/BootCurrent/Boot####, excludes raw values and descriptions, identifies BBS and hashes payloads.
Остаточный риск / блокер: No actual efivarfs capture on M75n; no proof BootFlow=7 occurs at ordinary boot or collision occurred, possible benign BDS changes. Runtime-visible inventory is not full NVRAM, no full device-path semantic validation; non-atomic capture and read errors flagged. Keep captures private; do not write boot options. B02/B05 remain partial.
